items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 May 2026 11:44am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 08 May 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in places later.


##Synopsis##

Low to the north of Scotland, moving to the Norwegian Sea.


##Wind##

Variable 1 to 3 in the east, north or northeast 2 to 4 in the west. Becoming a mainly northerly 3 or 4 by the end of the afternoon, increasing 5 in the west of the area this evening, then more generally 4 or 5 overnight and tomorrow morning, occasionally 6 in places.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Fair with isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northeast 5 to 6 Saturday afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday, and becoming 3 in the north during Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight.


##Weather##

Fair with isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
